kebab_example: aliyun ga list-listeners --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListListeners

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 50. The default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The transport layer protocol used by the listener
parameters.help_zh: 监听网络的传输协议类型
parameters.name: protocol

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance

BackendPorts.description_en: The port mapping of the backend server

items.description_en: The port mapping of the backend server

FromPort.description_en: The start port of the backend server
FromPort.description_zh: 后端服务器的起始端口

ToPort.description_en: The end port of the backend server
ToPort.description_zh: 后端服务器的结束端口

Certificates.description_en: The details of the SSL certificate

items.description_en: The details of the SSL certificate

Id.description_en: The ID of the SSL certificate

Type.description_en:
The type of the certificate.

Only Server, which indicates a server-side certificate, is returned
Type.description_zh:
证书类型。

目前，仅支持返回Server（服务端证书）

ClientAffinity.description_en:
Client affinity.

NONE: Client affinity is disabled. Requests from the same client are not always routed to the same endpoint.

SOURCE_IP: Client affinity is enabled. When a client accesses a stateful application, all requests from the same client are routed to the same endpoint regardless of the source port or protocol
ClientAffinity.description_zh:
客户端亲和性。

返回为NONE时：不保持客户端亲和性，即不能确保来自同一客户端的连接请求始终定向到同一终端节点。

返回为SOURCE_IP时，保持客户端亲和性。即客户端访问有状态的应用程序时，可以将来自同一客户端的所有请求都定向到同一终端节点，而不考虑源端口和协议

CreateTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp that indicates when the listener was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建监听的时间戳。单位：毫秒

HttpVersion.description_en:
The maximum version of the HTTP protocol. Valid values:

http3: HTTP/3.

http2: HTTP/2.

http1.1: HTTP/1.1.

This parameter is available only for HTTPS listeners
HttpVersion.description_zh:
HTTP协议的最大版本，取值：
http3：HTTP/3。
http2：HTTP/2。
http1.1：HTTP/1.1。
仅HTTPS监听支持此参数

IdleTimeout.description_en: The timeout period of idle connections. Unit: seconds
IdleTimeout.description_zh: 连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒

FromPort.description_en: The start port used to receive and forward requests to endpoints
FromPort.description_zh: 用来接收请求并向终端节点进行转发的起始监听端口

ToPort.description_en: The end port used to receive and forward requests to endpoints
ToPort.description_zh: 用来接收请求并向终端节点进行转发的结束监听端口

Protocol.description_en:
The transport layer protocol used by the listener.

TCP: TCP.

UDP: UDP.

HTTP: HTTP.

HTTPS: HTTPS
Protocol.description_zh:
监听的网络传输协议类型。
TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
HTTP：HTTP协议。
HTTPS：HTTPS协议

ProxyProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether the proxy protocol is used to preserve client IP addresses.

true: The proxy protocol is used to preserve client IP addresses. After you enable the proxy protocol, you can retrieve the source IP addresses of clients from the backend servers.

false: The proxy protocol is not used to preserve client IP addresses
ProxyProtocol.description_zh:
是否开启了保持客户端源IP功能。

true：开启了保持客户端源IP功能。开启后，支持后端服务查看客户端的原始IP地址。

false：未开启保持客户端源IP功能

RequestTimeout.description_en:
The timeout period for HTTP or HTTPS requests. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is available only for HTTP and HTTPS listeners. If a backend server does not respond within the timeout period, Global Accelerator returns an HTTP 504 error to the client
RequestTimeout.description_zh:
HTTP/HTTPS的连接请求超时时间。单位：秒。
仅对Protocol（网络传输协议类型）为HTTP或HTTPS的监听有效。如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，全球加速将放弃等待，并给客户端返回HTTP 504错误码

SecurityPolicyId.description_en:
The ID of the security policy instance.

tls_cipher_policy_1_0

Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, and TLSv1.2.

Supported cipher suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_1

Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.1 and TLSv1.2.

Supported cipher suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2

Supported TLS version: TLSv1.2.

Supported cipher suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict

Supported TLS version: TLSv1.2.

Supported cipher suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, and ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3

Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3.

Supported cipher suites: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, and ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA.

This parameter is available only for HTTPS listeners

    - 支持的TLS版本：TLSv1.0、TLSv1.1和TLSv1.2。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、AES128-GCM-SHA256、AES256-GCM-SHA384、AES128-SHA256、AES256-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA、AES128-SHA、AES256-SHA和DES-CBC3-SHA。

tls_cipher_policy_1_1

    - 支持的TLS版本： TLSv1.1和TLSv1.2。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、AES128-GCM-SHA256、AES256-GCM-SHA384、AES128-SHA256、AES256-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA、AES128-SHA、AES256-SHA和DES-CBC3-SHA。

tls_cipher_policy_1_2

    - 支持的TLS版本：TLSv1.2。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、AES128-GCM-SHA256、AES256-GCM-SHA384、AES128-SHA256、AES256-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA、AES128-SHA、AES256-SHA和DES-CBC3-SHA。

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict

    - 支持的TLS版本：TLSv1.2。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA和ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA。

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3

    - 支持的TLS版本：TLSv1.2及TLSv1.3。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256、TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384、TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256、TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256、TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the instance.

This parameter is returned only if ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is a managed instance. Valid values:

true: The instance is a managed instance.

false: The instance is not a managed instance
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：
true：是托管实例。
false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The actions that you can perform on the managed instance.

This parameter is returned only if ServiceManaged is set to True.

When an instance is managed, you cannot perform some operations on the instance
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The actions that you can perform on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:

Create: Create an instance.

Update: Update the current instance.

Delete: Delete the current instance.

Associate: Associate the instance with other resources.

UserUnmanaged: Unmanage the instance.

CreateChild: Create a child resource in the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener.

IpSet: acceleration region.

EndpointGroup: endpoint group.

ForwardingRule: forwarding rule.

Endpoint: endpoint.

EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping of an endpoint group that is associated with a custom routing listener.

EndpointPolicy: traffic policy for an endpoint that is associated with a custom routing listener.

This parameter is returned only if the value of Action is CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the specified action is managed. Valid values:

true: The action is managed. You cannot perform the specified action on the managed instance.

false: The action is not managed. You can perform the specified action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The status of the listener.

active: The listener is running.

init: The listener is being initialized.

updating: The listener is being updated.

deleting: The listener is being deleted
State.description_zh:
监听的状态。

active：正常。 

init：初始化。

updating：配置中。

deleting：删除中

Type.description_en:
The routing type of the listener.

Standard: smart routing.

CustomRouting: custom routing
Type.description_zh:
监听的路由类型。

Standard：智能路由类型。

CustomRouting：自定义路由类型

XForwardedForGaApEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-AP` header is used to retrieve the acceleration region information.

true

false

This parameter is available only for HTTP and HTTPS listeners
XForwardedForGaApEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-AP`字段获取加速地域信息。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForGaIdEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-ID` header is used to retrieve the ID of the GA instance.

true

false

This parameter is available only for HTTP and HTTPS listeners
XForwardedForGaIdEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-ID`头字段获取全球加速实例ID。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForPortEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-X-Forward-Port` header is used to retrieve the listener port of the GA instance.

true

false

This parameter is available only for HTTP and HTTPS listeners
XForwardedForPortEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-X-Forward-Port`字段获取全球加速实例的监听端口。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForProtoEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-X-Forward-Proto` header is used to retrieve the listener protocol of the GA instance.

true

false

This parameter is available only for HTTP and HTTPS listeners
XForwardedForProtoEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-X-Forward-Proto`字段获取全球加速实例的监听协议。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XRealIpEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Real-IP` header is used to retrieve the real IP address of the client.

true

false

This parameter is available only for HTTP and HTTPS listeners
XRealIpEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`X-Real-IP`字段获取真实的客户端IP。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
